issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other (Water & Water Deposit 56,820.55; Sewer 37,462.12; Trash 18,204.89)
issues.issue: Utility fund receipts belong in category Utility Charges (incl. trash/garbage) under the user rule of 2026-10-28. The same applies to receipts[18] and receipts[19]. The printed label only says 'Other', so user_rules.py will not recategorize them. Treating them as utility charges is an assumption (marked review).

issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other (Asset Mgmt 284.76, Water Bond 40.45, Water Reserve 88.19, Sewer Reserve 124.80)
issues.issue: These are savings-account funds and the extractor assumed the receipts are interest. If they are interest, the user's category is Interest Income, not investment income. Applies to receipts[20]-[23].
